title: Improve Your English Listening & Speaking 🎧 Simple Story: My Daily Routine

source.translation: Bản dịch tiếng Việt do Lumos thực hiện

cues.en: Hello everyone!
Today will spend a day with Jessica.
Who will take us through her daily routine, from morning until night.
This story will help you learn some useful.
English phrases in a simple relatable way.
Listen closely and try to repeat some of the phrases yourself.
It's a great way, to improve your English and get comfortable with everyday expressions.
Now I'd love to hear from you.
What's your daily routine like do you have any special habits or favorite activities?
Or maybe there's a story theme you'd love to see in future videos?
Let me know in the comments below.
Your ideas might just be featured in our next video.
Let's learn and grow together thanks for watching and enjoy the story with Jessica.
Here we go!
LISTEN CAREFULLY Hi! I'm Jessica.
My day starts at 7 a.m.
I wake up and stretch.
I take a deep breath to wake up my body.
Then, I brush my teeth and wash my face.
After that, I put on my favorite nightgown.
It's light blue and soft.
I head to the kitchen.
For breakfast, I make toast, scrambled eggs, and coffee.
"Breakfast is the most important meal of the day," I say to myself.
After breakfast, I change into my work clothes.
I wear a blouse and trousers.
I grab my bag and my keys, and I head out.
I take the bus to work.
On the bus, I listen to a podcast.
I enjoy learning something new each day.
"Every day is a chance to grow," I think.
I work as a project manager.
My day begins with checking emails.
I plan my tasks for the day.
Around noon, I have lunch with my coworkers.
We talk about the weekend or news.
"It's nice to take a break," I think.
After lunch, I go back to my desk.
Sometimes, I feel sleepy in the afternoon.
I take a short walk around the office.
"A little movement keeps me energized," I remind myself.
I finish work at 5 p.m.
I head home and change into a warm sweater.
I make myself some tea.
For dinner, I have something light, like a salad or soup.
In the evening, I like to relax.
I read a book or watch a show.
At 9 p.m., I start my night routine.
I wash up and change into my nightgown.
I write in my journal.
"Today was a good day," I write.
I go to bed at 10 p.m., ready for a new day.
Thank you for spending the day with me!
I hope my story helped you learn some English phrases.
Now, I'd love to hear about your day!
What's something you do every day, like a special morning habit or a way you relax in the evening?
Share it in the comments, and try using one of the words we practiced today.
Remember, small steps every day can make a big difference in your English skills.
Thanks again for joining me, and see you next time!
Before we start the speaking practice.
Let's look at some Key Words and Phrases from story.
Wake up To stop sleeping.
Example "I wake up at 7 a.m. every day."
Stretch To extend your arms and legs.
Example "I stretch in the morning to feel awake."
Deep breath To take a big breath of air.
Example "Taking a deep breath helps me relax."
Brush teeth To clean your teeth.
Example "I brush my teeth after waking up."
Favorite The thing you like best.
Example "This nightgown is my favorite."
Simple meal A meal that is easy to make.
Example "I make a simple meal for breakfast."
Important Something that matters a lot.
Example "Breakfast is an important meal."
Work clothes The clothes you wear to work.
Example "I wear a blouse and trousers as work clothes."
Grab To quickly take something.
Example "I grab my bag and leave."
Project manager A job that plans and manages tasks.
Example "I work as a project manager."
Respond To reply to someone.
Example "I respond to emails at work."
Coworkers The people you work with.
Example I have lunch with my coworkers."
Short walk A quick walk.
Example "I take a short walk to feel refreshed."
Energized To feel awake and full of energy.
Example "A walk makes me feel energized."
Unwind To relax after a long day.
Example "I like to unwind by reading."
Now is time for English speaking practice.
Let's repeat after Jessica.
